columns.name: number_of_solution_path_need_compiled
columns.description: Number of solution paths that need to be compiled if the user wants to implement the repository, replace NULL values with 0. A solution path is considered to need compilation refers to WasCompiled = 0.

columns.name: has_forks_higher_than_half_of_watchers
columns.description: Set to 1 if the number of forks is higher than half of the number of watchers; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: average_time_needed_for_the_solutions
columns.description: Average processed time needed to implement the solutions in the repository.

columns.name: percentage_of_solutions_compiled_XML
columns.description: Among all methods whose comments are in XML format within the repository, the percentage of those methods whose associated solution needs to be compiled (WasCompiled = 0).

columns.name: has_solution_without_compilation
columns.description: Set to 1 if the repository has at least one solution that does not need to be compiled; otherwise, set to 0. A solution is considered to not need compilation refers to WasCompiled = 1.
